{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted charcoal wool-blend blazer is not needed here as a separate layer choice, so the outer layer is a coat: see the last garment line.

Fine-knit merino turtleneck, slim cut, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool flannel
Textured tweed blazer, tailored single-breasted, hip length, grey-brown (#6E6259), wool blend
Tailored overcoat, single-breasted, knee length, camel (#B58B5A), wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather with a grip sole
Wool scarf, large and soft, deep burgundy (#6B2433), brushed wool
Leather gloves, lined, wrist length, black (#1C1C1C), soft leather
Structured tote bag, medium size, black (#1C1C1C), grained leather

This outfit keeps the neat business look the office asks for, with a turtleneck, trousers and a textured blazer in calm, muted tones. The layers of fine merino, flannel, tweed and a wool-cashmere overcoat hold the warmth you need for a frosty walk to work, and the scarf and gloves protect the neck and hands. The block-heel boots with a grip sole keep your steps steady on cold, possibly slippery pavement. The camel coat and burgundy scarf add colour to the neutral base, and the tote carries your work things neatly."}
